## Engineering review activity, where your team already works

Review activity shouldn't be locked inside one app. The Enterprise API lets you pull review and comment data out of CoLab and into analytics platforms like Power BI, internal dashboards, audit systems, and traceability records.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5e4d9854e6dad067f4b514b3/6a2abbf9c0488dd0c934a225_Screenshot%202026-06-11%20at%2011.10.39%E2%80%AFAM.avif)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5e4d9854e6dad067f4b514b3/6a2ad5d1c0d9451747476300_api_object_model_no_black_background.png)

## Built around CoLab's data model

The Enterprise API spans the full object model: workspaces, users, roles, directories, files, reviews, feedback, and comments, with a growing set of 50+ endpoints.

Most objects support create, read, update, and delete. Every API action is audit logged, supporting teams with traceability requirements.

## Connect CoLab to anything

CoLab provides native integrations for the major CAD and PLM systems. For everything else: internal tools, custom workflows, and in-house analytics, the API is how you connect them.

All API traffic is TLS/SSL only, customer data is encrypted at rest with AES-256, and the Enterprise API is rate-limited at the edge.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5e4d9854e6dad067f4b514b3/6a357d8b47bc09b5a67abf48_Group%201010111260%20(1).png)
